request: Could the theme go teal instead of ocean? The blue felt heavy on my eyes at the stall, and teal feels fresher when the sun is out.
I would like the colour pink instead of the ocean blue, because the old colour made the screen look cold and my clients noticed.
The target should begin at 30 rather than 20, because my weekly class needs a bit more reach, and it saves me changing it every Monday.
Could the colour be grey rather than ocean? Grey is calmer on the screen, and the figures are easier to read when the light is poor.
The Book is a better name than Baby supplies, because I use the app as a record of everything I buy for my little one.
Pulse suits this app more than School fees, since it is about how my family is doing each day and not just what we pay.
The share should default to 15000 rather than 10000, because that is the cut my partners agreed on, and I do not want to retype it.
My Corner feels right for the wish list, since it is a private place where I note things to buy later.
The colour should go green instead of slate, because the grey-blue was hard to tell apart from the other apps, and green is easy to find.
Could the colour become pink instead of ocean? The blue is too cold for a screen I check while the children are around, and pink feels warmer.
Ledger suits this app now, because it tracks the bills and receipts I used to lose in a drawer, and the old name Walks told me nothing.
The goal should begin at 75 instead of 60, because that is the number my class should reach this term, and having it there from the start helps.
Keeper is a better name than Timetable, because the app now keeps my notes for each lesson, not only the times I teach them.
Daily Log describes it better than First words, since I write a short line about my farm every morning and that is what the app is for.
Could the theme be yellow instead of mint? It is bright enough to read at the market and it makes the sales figures stand out.
Could the theme go grey instead of plum? I want the screen to look quiet while I work, so that the numbers are the first thing I see.
The Book suits it better, because the app holds all my recipe notes in one place, and the old name First aid did not fit.
I would rather call the app The Book, since it is where I keep my plant notes in order, and Plant care only covers part of it.
Grey would suit the screen better than plum, because the bright colour distracts me when I am doing the daily stock count and I need to focus.
I would like the theme purple rather than slate, since purple reads well in the evening and the screen does not look so grim.
Could the name be Nest instead of Homework In? The app now holds our whole family routine, so a warmer name feels more like home to me.
